newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom 1996 net will depend on Timeplex.
newsitem.headline: Ascom 1996 net will depend on Timeplex.

text.p: Ascom chairman Felix Wittlin, chairman of Ascom Holding AG, said the group's 1996 net profit would depend on possible provisions and restructuring costs in connection with the search for a partner for troubled unit Ascom unit Timeplex.
"The group net profit will strongly depend on the search for a partner (for Timeplex)," Wittlin said.
Wittlin was speaking to reporters during a news conference to present half-year results.

Ascom reported a first-half operating profit of 39 million Swiss francs and restructuring costs and provisions for Timeplex were the main reasons for extraordinary charges of 15 million in that period.
In 1995, Ascom reported a net profit of 25 million, up from 21 million in the prior year.
